title: Baseline Tap House | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: BaseLine Tap House Located in Grand Avenue at Disney's Hollywood Studios Venture down to this cheery corner pub specializing in California brews and wine.View Menu American Bar-Lounge Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Operating Hours – 10:30 AM to 9:00 PM Valid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type. An Important Message Valid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type.The MoodThe industrial buzz of modern-day Downtown Los Angeles is bottled in the re-imagined Grand Avenue area of Disney’s Hollywood Studios. Among the bustling office and warehouse exteriors is a charming little brick building fizzing with character. The interior aesthetics pay homage to the Figueroa Printing Company—a mom-and-pop print house that once enjoyed a flourishing partnership with Disney Studios. If you’d prefer the terrace, step outside and shade yourself under a picturesque tree canopy.The FoodA flavor-forward menu of small bites and dreamy flights is the perfect way to savor the afternoon or cap an evening. The crowning glory of BaseLine Tap House’s offerings are—without a doubt—its broad selection of California craft ales, lagers and cider. Don’t let that deter you from trying the variety of California wines on tap or specialty cocktails! There’s plenty of gourmet nonalcoholic lemonade and soda to go around, too. Soak up these sensational suds with a Bavarian pretzel slathered in mustard and beer-cheese fondue, house-made kettle chips or a charcuterie board highlighting delicious California cheeses.Times for BaseLine Tap House
